title: ビッグペインを知ってこそ

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Argh! My heart wants nothing more than to run! But my legs just won't move… I didn't know coming up short could be this painful.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But after watching some other racers training for the Mile Championship, I realize that everyone is suffering from various hardships too.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The deeper the despair, the greater the hope that comes from it! I will rise… and spread hope to the world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If my breathing won't cooperate with me, then I'll just have to work on my explosive power! That's my best bet right now!
